prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve partial character variation.
Asset type: transparent HEAD-ONLY inset sprite for the approved Yumemi sailor-uniform bonus portrait.
The supplied image is the APPROVED base portrait of Yumemi, an adult woman about 25 years old. The base full-body image will stay unchanged. Generate ONLY a separate matching head-and-upper-neck cutout WITH GLASSES for an inset. Do NOT redraw a full body.
Preserve the exact character face, gentle shy smile, violet eyes, lavender straight hair with bangs, small lavender flower clip, dangling earring, and the same three-quarter head angle and gaze as the reference. Match the original polished anime visual novel rendering and adult age. No new hairstyle, no new facial expression, no skin-tone changes.
The ONLY new accessory is a pair of CLEAR-LENS THICK-FRAMED GLASSES in a deep muted VIOLET / PURPLE color matching her sailor neckerchief and hair palette. Slightly rectangular frames with gently rounded corners; clearly substantial acetate rims, not thin metal, not rimless. Normal wearable size proportionate to her face, not giant novelty glasses. Both lenses, bridge and temples must sit correctly in perspective on her nose and ears. Keep her violet eyes visible through clean transparent lenses, no opaque reflections or tinted sunglasses.
Framing: only one complete head from the top of the hair to the chin and short upper neck. Preserve the full cranial silhouette, bangs, flower accessory and earring without cropping the top or sides; omit the long trailing hair and body below the head/upper-neck inset boundary. Place the head centered, occupying most of a square canvas with a modest clean transparent margin. No additional panels, duplicate heads, labels, captions or extra accessories. No shoulders or torso.
Genuinely transparent alpha background with clean character cutout edges; no scenery, solid backdrop, glow, halo, shadow, border or painted checkerboard. This must be a separate head PNG, approximately 1024x1024, ready to show at approximately the same head size as the full-body portrait's original head.
